Cambio 15 (game/enemies/lurker/lurker_brain.gd): anade justo ANTES de la linea `# --- Closing in and the warning ------------------------------------------------------------`:
```gdscript
# --- The silent ambush (iteration 3, H2) ------------------------------------------------

## Now and then, instead of following a prey on the move, she goes hidden by
## the plenum to a ceiling ahead of them, comes out and waits there, still
## and silent; the warning straight from it as they pass under or beyond her,
## nothing of her heard before. Back to stalking if they do not come in
## AMBUSH_WAIT s, go AMBUSH_LEAVE m off or hide; a failed ambush is no attempt.
const AMBUSH_WAIT := 12.0
const AMBUSH_LEAVE := 16.0
## m/s: a prey this fast is on the move, worth waiting for ahead.
const AMBUSH_MOVING := 1.0
var ambush_odds := 0.3
## Where she waits (INF: where she is, for force()), and the share of
## stalking she would have had.
var ambush_point := Vector3.INF
var ambush_share := 1.0

## Stalking for `share`, or now and then an ambush ahead of a prey on the move.
func begin_hunt(p, share: float) -> void:
	var seen = known(p)
	if seen != null and float(seen.speed) >= AMBUSH_MOVING and rng.randf() < ambush_odds:
		var at: Vector3 = world.ambush_point(seen)
		if at != Vector3.INF:
			ambush_point = at
			ambush_share = share
			enter(State.AMBUSH)
			return
	begin_stalk(share)

func ambush_tick(p) -> Dictionary:
	var seen = known(p)
	if seen == null: return lose(p)
	var v = p.victim
	if cue_ready(p):
		var entry: Dictionary = warning.start(prey, clock, window, float(v.latency), p.face, bool(v.above))
		enter(State.CUE)
		cue_started.emit(entry)
		return hold(v.eye)
	if state_time > AMBUSH_WAIT or float(seen.distance) > AMBUSH_LEAVE or (v != null and (bool(v.hidden) or not bool(v.fair))):
		begin_stalk(ambush_share)
		return pause(seen.eye)
	var face: Vector3 = p.face
	if ambush_point != Vector3.INF and Vector2(ambush_point.x - face.x, ambush_point.z - face.z).length() > ARRIVE_NEAR:
		if bool(p.failed):
			begin_stalk(ambush_share)
			return pause(seen.eye)
		return go(ambush_point, CRAWL_SPEED, Vector3.INF, true)
	return hold(seen.eye)

```

lurker.gd: la linterna que bebe a veces se apaga del todo (H1). En red: el anfitrion sortea con su rng (torch_kill) que linternas de las bebidas mueren y lo manda en el mismo evento fiable "scare" (dato 5); cada maquina guarda dead_torches. El estado del interruptor de cada jugador ya viaja: el local lo tiene exacto y el de los demas llega en su paquete de estado (bit 2 de flags, match_net), asi que el anfitrion vigila el interruptor de cada linterna muerta y, al pasar de apagado a encendido, manda un evento fiable nuevo "torch" [asiento, "back"] si la bebida ya acabo (vuelve la luz) o "spark" si no (un chispazo de 0,2 s y oscura otra vez). Ninguna maquina decide sola. El interruptor queda encendido aunque no de luz (torch.visible sigue como lo puso su dueño; solo torch_dim baja a 0), asi que hace falta el ciclo. NO toques apply_intent, unseen_now ni nada de la huida (otro agente). Ocho cambios exactos con Edit.

```gdscript
## Where she lies in wait for somebody on the move (iteration 3, H2): a dark
## ceiling AMBUSH_AHEAD metres ahead of them by their eased heading and pace,
## out of their sight now (round a corner, or out of their torch), never in a
## lit, protected or off-limits room nor on another planta; over a corridor or
## round a corner first. INF with none.
const AMBUSH_AHEAD := Vector2(8.0, 14.0)
const AMBUSH_TURNS := [0.0, 20.0, -20.0, 40.0, -40.0]
func ambush_point(seen) -> Vector3:
	var heading := flat_heading(seen)
	var eye: Vector3 = seen.eye
	var ahead := clampf(AMBUSH_AHEAD.x + float(seen.speed) * 1.5, AMBUSH_AHEAD.x, AMBUSH_AHEAD.y)
	var off: Array = level.off_limits_rooms() if level.has_method("off_limits_rooms") else []
	var best := Vector3.INF
	var best_score := INF
	for turn in AMBUSH_TURNS:
		var way := heading.rotated(Vector3.UP, deg_to_rad(float(turn)))
		for share in [1.0, 0.8, 1.2]:
			var at: Vector3 = eye + way * ahead * float(share)
			var r := int(FLOOR.room_at(level.manifest.rooms, at).get("id", -1))
			if r < 0 or not shell.tray_of.has(r) or off.has(r): continue
			var p: Vector3 = shell.anchor_of(shell.tray_state(r, at.x, at.z))
			if FLOOR.planta_of(p.y) != FLOOR.planta_of(eye.y) or level.point_protected(p) or SIGHT.lit_point(level, p): continue
			var walled: bool = not SIGHT.clear(level, eye, p, [get_rid()])
			if not walled and bool(seen.torch) and rad_to_deg((seen.view as Vector3).angle_to(p - eye)) < SIGHT.TORCH_FACE_ANGLE + 10.0: continue
			var score: float = absf(float(turn)) / 90.0 + absf(float(share) - 1.0) - (0.5 if walled else 0.0) - (0.5 if int(level.manifest.rooms[r].type) == OFFICE.CORRIDOR else 0.0)
			if score < best_score:
				best_score = score
				best = p
	return best

```

## A warning straight from an ambush (iteration 3, H2): she waits still over
## the way, the prey walks under and past her, and the warning starts there,
## with no silence nor closing in, its window kept as ever.
func ambush_rule() -> void:
	var brain = BRAIN.new()
	var draws := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	draws.seed = 3
	brain.setup(FakeWorld.new(), draws, WARNING.new())
	brain.tune(DIFFICULTY.profile("pesadilla", &"lurker"))
	brain.force(&"ambush", {"seat": 1})
	var face := Vector3(0, 2.2, 0)
	var x := -8.0
	var cue_from := -1
	var steps: Array = []
	for k in int(8.0 / DT):
		x += 3.8 * DT
		var p = SENSES.Percept.new()
		p.face = face
		var v = SENSES.Seen.new()
		v.seat = 1
		v.point = Vector3(x, 0, 0)
		v.eye = Vector3(x, 1.64, 0)
		v.view = Vector3(1, 0, 0)
		v.heading = Vector3(1, 0, 0)
		v.velocity = Vector3(3.8, 0, 0)
		v.speed = 3.8
		v.seen = true
		v.fair = true
		v.alone = 20.0
		v.distance = face.distance_to(v.eye)
		v.behind = SIGHT.behind_of(v.eye, v.view, face)
		v.above = SIGHT.over_of(v.eye, v.view, face)
		p.bodies[1] = v
		p.victim = v
		var was: int = brain.state
		brain.tick(DT, p)
		if brain.state != was: steps.append(BRAIN.NAMES[brain.state])
		if brain.state == BRAIN.State.CUE and was != BRAIN.State.CUE: cue_from = was
		if not brain.warning.ledger.is_empty() and brain.warning.active.is_empty(): break
	var entry: Dictionary = brain.warning.ledger[brain.warning.ledger.size() - 1] if not brain.warning.ledger.is_empty() else {}
	var ok: bool = cue_from == int(BRAIN.State.AMBUSH) and WARNING.audit(brain.warning.ledger).is_empty() and String(entry.get("outcome", "")) == "taken" and float(entry.take_at) - float(entry.at) >= float(entry.window) - EPS
	check("Desde la emboscada avisa al pasar por debajo, sin silencio ni acercamiento, y respeta la ventana", ok, "%s %s" % [str(steps), str(entry)])

## A turn at her with the torch up just before the due time (a fresh Callable each time).
func turn_late() -> Callable:
	var turned := [false]
	var each := func(brain):
		var active: Dictionary = lurker.warning.active
		if not turned[0] and not active.is_empty() and brain.clock >= float(active.due) - 0.3:
			turned[0] = true
			aim_at(lurker.face_point())
	return each

## A torch she put out (iteration 3, H1): no light for her even once her drink
## is over; switched off and on again, it is a torch again and saves.
func dead_torch() -> void:
	var seat := int(level.player.slot)
	await set_up(true, true)
	lurker.thinking = false
	lurker.drink_torches([seat], 0.3)
	lurker.kill_torches([seat])
	for i in 40: await physics_frame
	lurker.thinking = true
	lurker.brain.force(&"creep", {"seat": seat})
	var taken := await run_cue(6.0, turn_late())
	await set_up(true, true)
	lurker.thinking = false
	lurker.kill_torches([seat])
	var dark: bool = lurker.dead_torches.has(seat)
	level.player.torch.visible = false
	for i in 3: await physics_frame
	level.player.torch.visible = true
	for i in 3: await physics_frame
	var back: bool = not lurker.dead_torches.has(seat)
	lurker.thinking = true
	lurker.brain.force(&"creep", {"seat": seat})
	var saved := await run_cue(6.0, turn_late())
	var ok: bool = not taken.is_empty() and String(taken.outcome) == "taken" and dark and back and not saved.is_empty() and String(saved.outcome) == "saved" and String(saved.reason) == "linterna"
	check("Parte A: con la linterna apagada por ella, girarse no la salva; apagada y encendida, vuelve y salva", ok, "%s %s %s %s" % [str(dark), str(back), str(taken), str(saved)])
	lurker.drunk.clear()
	level.player.torch_dim = 1.0
